chapter_summary: The ordinary men and their ordinary sleep; what it means to labor against a world that is turned away. The poem listens to the breathing of the houses and sets it against the silence in which the artist alone is awake.

workshop.expansion: From the epic: flat continuous poetic prose grounded in the Night-of-the-Artist cycle.
